chapter: Erroll Garner, the 1952 arrest and Florida
title: Joining Erroll Garner and the first Ralph Bass records
summary: He joined Garner in New York after the late 1948 Los Angeles sessions sold to Savoy.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I had played Rock Island before the Roost.
Yeah, but after the Roost --
Then I came back out here.
Yeah. Then where did you play?
I came back out here with Garner.
Uh-huh. That's when you joined Erroll.
Yeah.
You joined Erroll in New York or out here?
I joined him in New York. See, he said if anything come of the records that I had a job.
Which records were these?
The ones we made out here for Ralph Bass, his first records that made him a hit.
And those were made --
Here in Los Angeles,
In what year?
'48, late '48. And Erroll -- about December, '48.
Do you remember what you recorded with him?
Oh, some of the tunes. "Cottage For
Sale", "Penthouse Serenade", "I'm In the Mood for Love", you name it.
What label were these on?
They weren't on a label. See, Ralph Bass just give us a record date and he took the masters and sold them to Savoy.
So they came out on Savoy.
They came out on Savoy. But we didn't record for Savoy.
Uh-huh. Who played drums on these records?
